fullincense: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that makes the holder bloated and slow moving.
waveincense: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is incense with a curious aroma that boosts the power of Water-type moves.
roseincense: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that boosts the power of Grass-type moves.
luckincense: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It doubles a battle's prize money if the holding Pokémon joins in.
pureincense: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It helps keep wild Pokémon away if the holder is the first one in the party.
protector: A protective item of some sort. It is extremely stiff and heavy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.
electirizer: A box packed with a tremendous amount of electric energy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.
magmarizer: A box packed with a tremendous amount of magma energy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.
dubiousdisc: A transparent device overflowing with dubious data. Its producer is unknown.
reapercloth: A cloth imbued with horrifyingly strong spiritual energy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.
razorclaw: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a sharply hooked claw that ups the holder's critical-hit ratio.
razorfang: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It may make foes and allies flinch when the holder inflicts damage.
tm01: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.
tm02: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws.
tm03: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.
tm04: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.
tm05: The target is scared off and replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.
tm06: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.
tm07: Summons a hailstorm that lasts for five turns. The hailstorm damages all types except Ice.
tm08: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting both its Attack and Defense stats.
tm09: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. Its power is doubled if the target is poisoned.
tm10: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.
tm11: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.
tm12: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.
tm13: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. It may also freeze the target solid.
tm14: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the opposing team. It may also freeze them solid.
tm15: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.
tm16: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from special attacks for five turns.
tm17: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
tm18: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves.
tm19: The user makes the target float with its psychic power. The target is easier to hit for three turns.
tm20: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.
tm21: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.
tm22: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.
tm23: The user throws a stone or projectile to attack an opponent. A flying Pokémon will fall to the ground when it's hit.
tm24: A strong electric blast is loosed at the target. It may also leave the target with paralysis.
tm25: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.
tm26: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.
tm27: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.
tm28: The user burrows, then attacks on the second turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.
tm29: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the target's Sp. Def stat.
tm30: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
tm31: The user attacks with tough fists, etc. It can also break any barrier such as Light Screen and Reflect.
tm32: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.
tm33: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.
tm34: It swamps the area around the user with a giant sludge wave. It may also poison those hit.
tm35: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.
tm36: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. It may also poison the target.
tm37: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except the Rock, Ground, and Steel types.
tm38: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.
tm39: Boulders are hurled at the target. It also lowers the target's Speed by preventing its movement.
tm40: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. The attack lands without fail.
tm41: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.
tm42: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.
tm43: The user cloaks itself with flame and attacks. Building up more power, it raises the user's Speed stat.
tm44: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user's HP and heals any status problem.
tm45: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.
tm46: The user attacks and steals the target's held item simultaneously. It can't steal if the user holds an item.
tm47: The user attacks the target's legs swiftly, reducing the target's Speed stat.
tm48: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round and make the attack do greater damage.
tm49: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. If this move is used every turn, it does greater damage.
tm50: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack's recoil harshly reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.
tm51: The user teleports using a strange power and switches its place with one of its allies.
tm52: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def.
tm53: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def.
tm54: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.
tm55: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. It may also leave the target with a burn.
tm56: The user flings its held item at the target as an attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.
tm57: The user attacks with an electric charge. The user may use any remaining electricity to raise its Sp. Atk stat.
tm58: The user hurls the target into the air, then drops it on the second turn. The target cannot attack while in the air.
tm59: The user attacks the target with fire. If the target is holding a Berry, the Berry becomes burnt up and unusable.
tm60: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.
tm61: The user shoots a sinister, bluish-white flame at the target to inflict a burn.
tm62: The user nimbly strikes the target. If the user is not holding an item, this attack inflicts massive damage.
tm63: It prevents the target from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.
tm64: The user explodes to inflict damage on those around it. The user faints upon using this move.
tm65: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
tm66: The user stores power, then attacks. If the user can use this attack after the target, its power is doubled.
tm67: The user gets revenge for a fainted ally. If an ally fainted in the previous turn, this attack's damage increases.
tm68: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.
tm69: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It sharply raises the Speed stat.
tm70: The user flashes a bright light that cuts the target's accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.
tm71: The user stabs the foe with sharpened stones from below. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
tm72: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
tm73: A weak electric charge is launched at the target. It causes paralysis if it hits.
tm74: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.
tm75: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user's Attack stat.
tm76: Resisting, the user attacks the opposing Pokémon. The targets' Sp. Atk stat is reduced.
tm77: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.
tm78: The user stomps down on the ground and attacks everything in the area. The targets' Speed stat is reduced.
tm79: The user blows a cold breath on the target. This attack always results in a critical hit.
tm80: Large boulders are hurled at the opposing team to inflict damage. They may also make the targets flinch.
tm81: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.
tm82: The user knocks away the target and drags out another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.
tm83: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.
tm84: The target is stabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped in poison. It may also poison the target.
tm85: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user's HP.
tm86: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the damage.
tm87: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, it also sharply raises the target's Attack stat.
tm88: The user pecks the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user plucks it and gains its effect.
tm89: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
tm90: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user's decoy.
tm91: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
tm92: The user creates a bizarre space in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.
hm01: The target is cut with a scythe or claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.
hm02: The user soars, then strikes on the second turn. It can also be used to fly to any familiar town.
hm03: It swamps the area around the user with a giant wave. It can also be used for crossing water.
hm04: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. This move can also be used to move boulders.
hm05: The user charges the target at an awesome speed. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.
hm06: Diving on the first turn, the user floats up and attacks on the second. It can be used for diving in the ocean.
explorerkit: A bag filled with convenient tools for exploring. It provides access to the Underground.
lootsack: A sturdy, spacious bag that is used to carry loot obtained in the coal mine.
rulebook: It lists the rules for holding battles. For linked battles, you may choose which set of rules you wish to use.
pokéradar: A tool that can search out Pokémon that are hiding in grass. Its battery is recharged as you walk.
pointcard: A card that lists the Battle Points you have earned.
journal: A notebook that keeps a day-to-day record of your adventure so far.
sealcase: A case for storing Seals that can be applied to the Capsule cases of Poké Balls.
fashioncase: A lovely case to store colorful Props for your Pokémon to wear in a musical.
sealbag: A tiny bag that can hold 10 Seals for decorating Poké Balls.
palpad: A convenient notepad that is used for registering your friends, Friend Codes, and keeping a record of game play.
workskey: A large key for operating the doors of the Valley Windworks in the canyon. It was held by a Team Galactic Grunt.
oldcharm: An ancient good-luck charm made of Pokémon bones to be taken to the elder of Celestic Town.
galactickey: A card key for disengaging security systems in the Galactic HQ. Losing it can result in punishment, apparently.
redchain: A mythical chain that is said to link the legendary Pokémon that created the Sinnoh region.
townmap: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows your present location.
vsseeker: A device that indicates Trainers who want to battle. Its battery charges while you walk.
coincase: A case for holding coins obtained at the Game Corner. It holds up to 50,000 coins.
oldrod: An old and beat-up fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.
goodrod: A new, good-quality fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.
superrod: An awesome, high-tech fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.
sprayduck: A watering can shaped like a Psyduck. It helps promote healthy growth of Berries planted in soft soil.
poffincase: A case for storing Poffin cooked from Berries.
bicycle: A folding Bicycle that enables much faster movement than the Running Shoes.
suitekey: A key to one of the suites at the luxury hotel by a lake. For some odd reason, it often disappears.
oaksletter: A letter from Prof. Oak. Written in it is a request for you to go to Rt. 224.
lunarwing: A feather that glows like the moon. It is said to possess the power to dispel nightmares.
membercard: A card needed for entering the inn in Canalave City. Oddly, the last date marked on it was 50 years ago.
azureflute: A flute that puts out echoing sounds that do not seem to be of this world. It is unknown who made it.
ssticket: The ticket required for sailing on the ferry S.S. Aqua. It has a drawing of a ship on it.
contestpass: The pass required for entering Pokémon Contests. It has a drawing of an award ribbon on it.
magmastone: A stone formed when boulders melted in intensely hot magma, then hardened. Magma remains sealed inside.
parcel: A parcel entrusted in your care. You are supposed to deliver it to your childhood friend who left Twinleaf Town.
coupon1: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch (Pokétch for short). Three coupons are needed.
coupon2: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch (Pokétch for short). Three coupons are needed.
coupon3: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch (Pokétch for short). Three coupons are needed.
storagekey: The key to Team Galactic's sinister warehouse located at the edge of Veilstone City.
secretpotion: A fantastic medicine dispensed by the pharmacy in Cianwood City. It fully heals a Pokémon of any ailment.
vsrecorder: An amazing device that can record a battle either between friends or at a special battle facility.
gracidea: A flower sometimes bundled in bouquets to convey gratitude on special occasions like birthdays.
secretkey: A high-tech key that has to be used at a specific location. It emits a special electric signal to open a door.
apricornbox: A handy box where you can store up to 99 Apricorns of each kind.
unownreport: A report of all the discovered kinds of Unown.
berrypots: Handy containers for cultivating Berries wherever you go.
dowsingmchn: It checks for unseen items in the area and makes noise and lights when it finds something.
bluecard: A card to save points for the Buena's Password show.
slowpokétail: A very tasty tail of something. It sells for a high price.
clearbell: A very old-fashioned bell that makes a gentle ringing.
cardkey: A card key that opens a shutter in the Radio Tower.
basementkey: A key that opens a door in the Goldenrod Tunnel.
squirtbottle: A bottle used for watering plants in the Berry Pots.
redscale: A scale from the red Gyarados. It glows red like a flame.
lostitem: The Mime Jr. doll that was lost by the Copycat.
pass: A ticket required for riding the Magnet Train. It allows you to ride whenever and however much you'd like.
machinepart: An important machine part for the Power Plant that was stolen.
silverwing: A strange, silvery feather that sparkles.
rainbowwing: A mystical rainbow feather that sparkles.
mysteryegg: A mysterious Egg obtained from Mr. Pokémon. What's in the Egg is unknown.
redapricorn: A red Apricorn. It assails your nostrils.
bluapricorn: A blue Apricorn. It smells a bit like grass.
ylwapricorn: A yellow Apricorn. It has an invigorating scent.
grnapricorn: A green Apricorn. It has a mysterious, aromatic scent.
pnkapricorn: A pink Apricorn. It has a nice, sweet scent.
whtapricorn: A white Apricorn. It doesn't smell like anything.
blkapricorn: A black Apricorn It has an indescribable scent.
fastball: A Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch Pokémon which are quick to run away.
levelball: A Poké Ball for catching Pokémon that are a lower level than your own.
lureball: A Poké Ball for catching Pokémon hooked by a Rod when fishing.
heavyball: A Poké Ball for catching very heavy Pokémon.
loveball: Poké Ball for catching Pokémon that are the opposite gender of your Pokémon.
friendball: A Poké Ball that makes caught Pokémon more friendly.
moonball: A Poké Ball for catching Pokémon that evolve using the Moon Stone.
sportball: A special Poké Ball for the Bug-Catching Contest.
parkball: A special Poké Ball for the Pal Park.
photoalbum: A nice photo album for storing all the photos taken along your adventure.
gbsounds: A music player that allows you to listen to nostalgic songs. It's operated with a single switch.
tidalbell: A very old-fashioned bell that makes a gentle ringing.
ragecandybar: A famous Mahogany Town candy tourists like to buy and take home. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 20 points.

datacard07: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won Pennant Capture.

datacard27: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how much time you've spent in the Pokéathlon.
jadeorb: A shiny green orb that is said to have a legend and has a deep connection with the Hoenn region.
lockcapsule: A sturdy Capsule that can only be opened with a special key.
redorb: A shiny red orb that is said to have a legend and has a deep connection with the Hoenn region.
blueorb: A shiny blue orb that is said to have a legend and has a deep connection with the Hoenn region.
enigmastone: A crystal ball that was excavated from the ground. A very beautiful stone that is covered with bits of rock and earth.
prismscale: A mysterious scale that evolves certain Pokémon. It shines in rainbow colors.
eviolite: A mysterious evolutionary lump. When held, it raises the Defense and Sp. Def of a Pokémon that can still evolve.
floatstone: A very light stone. It reduces the weight of a Pokémon when held.
rockyhelmet: If the holder of this item takes damage, the attacker will also be damaged upon contact.
airballoon: When held by a Pokémon, the Pokémon will float into the air. When the holder is attacked, this item will burst.
redcard: A card with a mysterious power. When the holder is struck by a foe, the attacker is removed from battle.
ringtarget: Moves that would otherwise have no effect will land on the Pokémon that holds it.
bindingband: A band that increases the power of binding moves when held.
absorbbulb: A consumable bulb. If the holder is hit by a Water-type move, its Sp. Atk will rise.
cellbattery: A consumable battery. If the holder is hit by an Electric-type move, its Attack will rise.
ejectbutton: If the holder is hit by an attack, it will switch with another Pokémon in your party.

watergem: A gem with an essence of water. When held, it strengthens the power of a Water-type move only once.
electricgem: A gem with an essence of electricity. When held, it strengthens the power of an Electric-type move only once.

healthwing: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the base HP of a single Pokémon.
musclewing: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the base Attack stat of a single Pokémon.
resistwing: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the base Defense stat of a single Pokémon.
geniuswing: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the base Sp. Atk stat of a single Pokémon.
cleverwing: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the base Sp. Def stat of a single Pokémon.
swiftwing: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the base Speed stat of a single Pokémon.
prettywing: Though this feather is beautiful, it's just a regular feather and has no effect on Pokémon.
coverfossil: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon that lived in the sea in ancient times. It appears to be part of its back.
plumefossil: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon that flew in the sky in ancient times. It appears to be part of its wing.
libertypass: A special pass to go to Liberty Garden. Board the ship in Castelia City.
passorb: A mysterious orb containing the power of the Unova region, to be used when generating Pass Power.
dreamball: A special Poké Ball that appears out of nowhere in a bag at the Entree Forest. It can catch any Pokémon.
pokétoy: An item that attracts Pokémon. Use it to flee from any battle with a wild Pokémon.
propcase: A lovely case to store colorful Props for your Pokémon to wear in a musical.
dragonskull: A skull of a Pokémon which was said to have braved the angry waters to fly around the world.
balmmushroom: A rare mushroom which gives off a nice fragrance. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
bignugget: A big nugget of pure gold that gives off a lustrous gleam. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
pearlstring: Very large pearls that sparkle in a pretty silver color. A maniac will buy them for a high price.
cometshard: A shard which fell to the ground when a comet approached. A maniac will buy it for a high price.

relicstatue: A stone figure made in a civilization about 3,000 years ago. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
reliccrown: A crown made in a civilization about 3,000 years ago. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
casteliacone: Castelia City's specialty, soft-serve ice cream. It heals all the status problems of a single Pokémon.

gram3: An important letter which Wingull delivers.

ovalcharm: An oval charm said to increase the chance of Eggs being found at the Day Care.

revealglass: A glass that reveals the truth. It is a mysterious glass that returns a Pokémon back to its original shape.
